🚪 Step Inside This Gorgeous Copperas Cove Home – This Sunday! #openhouse 

📍 1818 Castroville Trail, Copperas Cove, TX
🕐 Open House | Sunday from 1–4 PM
👋 Hosted by Kati Bennett, your trusted local listing agent

Come explore this inviting home in the popular Heartwood Park neighborhood! Thoughtfully designed with an open layout, modern touches, and a spacious fenced backyard—this home checks all the boxes for comfort and convenience.

✨ Features You’ll Love:
✔️ Light-filled living areas with a functional flow
✔️ Stylish kitchen + generous bedroom space
✔️ Perfect backyard for gatherings or pets
✔️ Minutes from Fort Cavazos, schools, and shopping

Thinking about making a move? Swing by, take a look around, and imagine yourself living here.

📲 Have questions or need a private tour? Reach out to Kati Bennett at 512.285.7724 or kati@i35group.com
